# pokeapi_mini

A hand-built, fictional world in PokéAPI's CSV layout (same file names and
columns as `data/v2/csv/`). No real names or game text. It exercises every
filter in `world/pokeapi.py`: a non-battle type, a non-main-series ability, a
move nobody learns, a learned move of a non-battle type, a non-English name and
flavor row, a Mega form with its own name, a form with only a form name, a
level-up move at level 0 and a machine move.
